'''Clan Jennis''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A number of Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] from Clan Jennis tracked down a shipment of stolen goods.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Jennis was first introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].
